'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Sibille Schöntauf DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Sibille Schöntauf]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Endor Ops. Line 31 Stop Motion (V) replaces struck Weapon Levitation. They're Still Coming Through! title may need wiki match.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Sibille Schöntauf]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
